title: Creating and Managing Work Items and Worklists for Customer Notifications
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM

e If notification is required, the system generates a notification work item . The CRM agent assigned to this work item must
contact the customer, set an agreed date and close the work item before the reconnection order can be processed further.

e If notification is not required, or if the notification work item is closed, you can continue processing the reconnection order.

Creating and Managing Work Items and Worklists for Customer Notifications

You can create work items and worklists for processing notifications related to reconnection and reconnection of services. To be
able to do so, you have to create organizational units in Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable, and assign the following
standard tasks to them:

e 21400001 - Disconnection notification agent

e 21400002 - Disconnection notification group

e 21400003 - Disconnection notification department
You can create a simple model using the report Create Organizational Model in ERP.
Automatic Assignment When Work Items are Created

To have automatic assignment when work items are created, you have to enter the responsibilities. On the SAP Easy Access
screen, choose |*Periodic Processing » For Contract Accounts » Dunning Notice » Areas of Responsibility

e Maintain Department Responsibilities
e Maintain Unit Responsibilities

e Maintain Collection Specialist Responsibilities

Managing Work Items and Worklists

To manage work items and worklists, you use the transaction Manage Worklists for Disconnection Notifications (from the SAP
Easy Access screen, choose |}UtilitiesIndustry » Customer Service » Process Execution » Disconnection/Reconnection » Work
Item Management)

In this transaction, the manager of a department or group can perform the following tasks:

e Create worklists manually

e Change attributes of a worklist

e Display work items

e Assign work items to new processors or groups

e Change the starting time of work items
Temporary Release of Additional Users for Managing and Processing Worklists

e You can temporarily release additional users for managing worklists, without having to change the organizational model. To
do so, on the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |}PeriodicProcessing » For ContractAccounts » Dunning » Areas
ofResponsibilities » Define Additional Department or Group Head

The work items are processed in the CRM system in Financial Customer Care (FCC).
